title: Eating out
about: Places where you can eat, the food on a restaurant menu, and simple phrases for ordering a meal, like 'I'd like…' and 'Could I have the bill, please?'.

items.pattern: go to a café · in a café · also spelt cafe
items.meaning: a small place where you can have a drink and a snack
items.example: We had hot chocolate in a little **café** near the park.
more: There's a nice **café** next to my school.
Mum met her friend at the **café** for lunch.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈkæfeɪ/, наголос на першому складі, а не на останньому, як в українському «кафе». Пишуть café або cafe.

items.phrase: have a cup of tea / coffee
items.pattern: have a cup of tea / coffee / hot chocolate
items.meaning: drink a cup of tea or coffee
items.example: When we got home, we **had a cup of tea** together.
more: Dad always **has a cup of coffee** after breakfast.
Would you like to **have a cup of tea** with us?
items.watchOut: «Випити чаю» англійською часто have a cup of tea. Have тут означає «їсти або пити»: have breakfast, have a snack, have a coffee.

items.pattern: have a snack · a quick snack
items.meaning: a little food that you eat between meals
items.example: We bought a **snack** at the station before the train.
more: An apple is a good **snack** after school.
I always take a **snack** to school.
items.watchOut: «Перекусити» — have a snack. Закуска на початку обіду в ресторані — це не snack, а starter.

items.pattern: have a meal · a hot meal · a family meal
items.meaning: breakfast, lunch or dinner; the food you eat at that time
items.example: We have a big family **meal** every Sunday.
more: Lunch is my favourite **meal** of the day.
Grandma cooked a lovely **meal** for us.
items.watchOut: Meal — це весь сніданок, обід чи вечеря. Окрема страва — a dish, а їжа взагалі — food.

items.pattern: go to a restaurant · eat at / in a restaurant
items.meaning: a place where you sit down and pay for a meal; it costs more than a café
items.example: We went to an Italian **restaurant** for my birthday.
more: This **restaurant** has a great view of the river.
My uncle works as a cook in a **restaurant**.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈrestrɒnt/ або /ˈrestərɒnt/, наголос на першому складі; середину слова часто ковтають.

items.pattern: go to a pub · in a bar
items.meaning: places where adults go for a drink; you can often eat there too
items.example: My parents had lunch with friends in a **pub** by the river.
more: The hotel has a **bar** and a café.
Many British **pubs** serve good food at lunchtime.
items.watchOut: Pub — типово британський заклад. Там не лише п'ють: удень у пабі часто обідають, іноді навіть цілими родинами.

items.pattern: drink alcohol · no alcohol
items.meaning: drinks like beer and wine; they are only for adults
items.example: This café doesn't serve **alcohol**, only tea, coffee and juice.
more: Children can't buy **alcohol** in shops.
Dad doesn't drink **alcohol** when he drives.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈælkəhɒl/, наголос на першому складі, h вимовляється.

items.pattern: a soft drink · soft drinks
items.meaning: a cold drink with no alcohol, like juice or lemonade
items.example: We took sandwiches and **soft drinks** to the beach.
more: At the party there were **soft drinks** for the children.
Most **soft drinks** have a lot of sugar.
items.watchOut: Soft drink — не «м'який напій», а будь-який безалкогольний: сік, лимонад, кола.

items.pattern: a fast food restaurant · fast food
items.meaning: a place where you get quick hot food, like burgers and chips
items.example: We were in a hurry, so we ate at a **fast food restaurant**.
more: There's a **fast food restaurant** in the shopping centre.
Don't eat **fast food** every day. It isn't healthy.
items.watchOut: Українською «фастфуд» часто кажуть і про заклад. Англійською fast food — це сама їжа, а місце — a fast food restaurant.

items.pattern: a take-away · get a take-away · also spelt takeaway
items.meaning: a place where you buy hot food and take it home to eat; also the food itself
items.uk: заклад, де продають їжу на винос; їжа на винос
items.example: Nobody wanted to cook, so we got a Chinese **take-away**.
more: There's a pizza **take-away** at the end of our street.
Our favourite **take-away** brings the food to our door.
items.watchOut: Це британське слово (американською — takeout). «Каву з собою» в кафе просять так: A coffee to take away, please (або to go).

items.pattern: the menu · on the menu · Can I see the menu?
items.meaning: a list of the food and drinks in a restaurant or café
items.example: Pizza isn't on the **menu** today.
more: Can we see the **menu**, please?
This café has a special **menu** for children.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈmenjuː/, наголос на першому складі. «У меню» — on the menu, а не in the menu.

items.pattern: a starter · as a starter · for a starter
items.meaning: a small dish you eat before the main dish
items.example: For a **starter**, my sister had a small salad.
more: The **starters** here are small, so we ordered three.
Are you having a **starter** or just a main course?
items.watchOut: Starter — британське слово, американці кажуть appetizer. Не плутай зі snack — перекусом між прийомами їжі.

items.pattern: the soup of the day · tomato / vegetable / chicken soup
items.meaning: the special soup that a restaurant makes today; it changes every day
items.example: What's the **soup of the day**? — Mushroom.
more: In winter Mum makes hot chicken **soup**.
Our school canteen has a **soup of the day** too.
items.watchOut: Суп англійською зазвичай eat або have: I had soup for lunch. Drink soup кажуть, лише коли п'ють його з чашки.

items.pattern: a mixed salad · a fruit salad · a tomato salad
items.meaning: cold vegetables (or pieces of fruit) cut up and mixed together
items.example: Can you help me make a **mixed salad** for dinner?
more: We had **fruit salad** with ice cream for dessert.
My brother never eats **salad**. He hates vegetables.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈsæləd/, наголос на першому складі. Fruit salad — це десерт. Листя салату — lettuce.

items.pattern: a main course · for the main course
items.meaning: the biggest dish of a meal
items.example: For the **main course** we had chicken and rice.
more: The **main courses** in this restaurant are very big.
I'm not very hungry. I'll just have a **main course**.
items.watchOut: «Друге», основна страва — main course, а не second dish.

items.pattern: a steak · steak with chips
items.meaning: a thick piece of beef that you fry or grill
items.example: Dad ordered a **steak** with salad.
more: This **steak** is too big for me.
My dad orders a **steak** every time we eat out.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /steɪk/, як у take, а не «стік».

items.pattern: chips · fish and chips · burger and chips
items.meaning: long pieces of potato cooked in hot oil
items.example: My little brother wants **chips** with everything.
more: We had **fish and chips** at the seaside.
Do you want rice or **chips** with your chicken?
items.watchOut: Британською chips — картопля фрі (американською fries). Те, що ми називаємо «чіпси» (тонкі скибочки в пакеті), британці називають crisps.

items.pattern: new potatoes
items.meaning: small young potatoes, usually boiled
items.example: We had fish with **new potatoes** and carrots.
more: Grandma grows **new potatoes** in her garden.
**New potatoes** are small, so you don't need to peel them.
items.watchOut: Молода картопля — new potatoes, а не young potatoes.

items.pattern: a curry · vegetable / chicken curry
items.meaning: a hot, spicy dish from India, often with rice
items.example: My aunt makes a great vegetable **curry** with rice.
more: Is the **curry** very spicy?
We cooked an Indian **curry** at my cousin's house.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈkʌri/, перший звук як у cup. Curry — і страва, і суміш спецій.

items.pattern: salmon · a salmon fillet
items.meaning: a big fish with pink meat
items.example: My mum cooks **salmon** in the oven with lemon.
more: My cat loves **salmon**.
A **salmon fillet** cooks in fifteen minutes.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈsæmən/, l не читається. A salmon fillet — філе лосося.

items.pattern: green beans
items.meaning: long, thin green vegetables
items.example: Can I have **green beans** instead of chips?
more: Mum puts **green beans** in her vegetable soup.
**Green beans** are good for you.
items.watchOut: Beans — квасоля, а green beans — зелені стручки. Зелений горошок — peas.

items.pattern: a burger · burger and chips · a cheeseburger
items.meaning: a flat round piece of meat, cooked and eaten in a bread roll
items.example: After football practice we all had **burgers**.
more: Can I have a **burger** with no onions?
There's a new **burger** place in town.

items.pattern: mushrooms · mushroom soup
items.meaning: small white or brown things that grow in forests and fields; you can cook and eat some of them
items.example: Mum fried some **mushrooms** with onions for breakfast.
more: Do you like **mushrooms** in your omelette?
Grandma makes **mushroom** soup in autumn.
items.watchOut: Грибний суп — mushroom soup: перше слово тут в однині, як прикметник.

items.pattern: dessert · for dessert · a dessert menu
items.meaning: sweet food you eat at the end of a meal
items.example: What's for **dessert**? — Chocolate cake!
more: We had strawberries for **dessert**.
I'm full, so no **dessert** for me, thanks.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /dɪˈzɜːt/, наголос на другому складі. Не плутай з desert /ˈdezət/ — пустеля (одна s). «На десерт» — for dessert.

items.pattern: ice cream · chocolate / vanilla ice cream · an ice cream
items.meaning: a very cold, sweet food made from milk
items.example: On hot days we always buy **ice cream** in the park.
more: My sister got **ice cream** all over her T-shirt.
**Ice cream** is my favourite dessert.
items.watchOut: Пишеться двома словами. Про морозиво взагалі — без a: I love ice cream. An ice cream — одна порція.

items.pattern: apple pie · chicken pie · a piece of pie
items.meaning: fruit or meat cooked inside pastry
items.example: Grandma makes the best apple **pie** in the world.
more: We had chicken **pie** for dinner.
Can I have another piece of **pie**?
items.watchOut: Pie — пиріг з начинкою всередині. Торт — cake.

items.pattern: be (a) vegetarian · vegetarian food / dishes · (v) on a menu
items.meaning: a person who doesn't eat meat or fish; food with no meat or fish in it
items.example: My best friend is **vegetarian**. She never eats meat.
more: Is the soup **vegetarian**?
This café has lots of **vegetarian** dishes.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˌvedʒəˈteəriən/, наголос на третьому складі (-te-). У меню (v) означає vegetarian.

items.pattern: Are you ready to order?
items.meaning: Do you know now what food you want?
items.example: The waiter waited until we were **ready to order**.
more: Are you **ready to order**, or do you need more time?
Take your time. Tell me when you're **ready to order**.
items.watchOut: Ready to order, а не ready for order: після ready тут to + дієслово.

items.pattern: I'd like + noun · I'd like to + verb
items.meaning: a polite way to say what you want
items.uk: Я хотів би … / Я хотіла б …; Мені, будь ласка, …
items.example: **I'd like** a cheese sandwich, please.
more: **I'd like** to try the fish today.
**I'd like** two tickets for the film, please.
items.watchOut: I'd like = I would like, ввічливе «хочу». I like — «мені подобається». I want у кафе може звучати різкувато.

items.pattern: Would you like + noun? · Would you like to + verb?
items.meaning: a polite question when you offer something or ask what somebody wants
items.example: **Would you like** some more juice?
more: **Would you like** to come to my party on Saturday?
**Would you like** a piece of cake?
items.watchOut: Would you like …? — ввічлива пропозиція. Do you like …? — питання, чи тобі взагалі щось подобається.

items.pattern: How would you like your steak / eggs / coffee?
items.meaning: a question about how you want your food cooked or made
items.example: **How would you like** your eggs? — Fried, please.
more: **How would you like** your hair today? — Short, please.
The waiter asked, '**How would you like** your steak?'
items.watchOut: «Як вам приготувати стейк?» — How would you like your steak?, а не What would you like your steak? What would you like? — це «Що ви бажаєте?».

items.pattern: rare · medium · well-done (about steak and other meat)
items.meaning: cooked a little and red inside / cooked a bit more and pink inside / cooked a lot and brown all through
items.uk: з кров'ю / середнього просмаження / добре просмажений
items.example: I don't like my meat red inside, so I always have my steak **well-done**.
more: I can't eat **rare** meat. It's too red for me.
My mum orders her steak **medium**: a little pink inside.
items.watchOut: Добре просмажений — well-done, а не good done. Rare тут означає не «рідкісний», а «з кров'ю».

items.phrase: What would you like to drink?
items.pattern: What would you like to drink / eat?
items.meaning: a polite question about which drink someone wants
items.example: **What would you like to drink**? — Apple juice, please.
more: Grandpa asked the guests, '**What would you like to drink**?'
**What would you like to eat**, kids? — Pizza!
items.watchOut: Порядок слів у питанні: What would you like to drink?, а не What you would like to drink?

items.pattern: I'll have + food / drink (, please)
items.meaning: what you say when you choose your food or drink in a café or restaurant
items.example: **I'll have** the chicken salad, please.
more: **I'll have** the same as my sister, please.
**I'll have** a lemonade, please.
items.watchOut: «Я візьму піцу» в кафе британці зазвичай кажуть I'll have the pizza. I'll take частіше чути в магазині, коли купують річ.

items.pattern: Is everything all right (with your meal)?
items.meaning: a question from a waiter: are you happy with your food?
items.example: The waiter came back and asked, '**Is everything all right**?'
more: **Is everything all right**? You look worried.
**Is everything all right** with your room?

items.pattern: be delicious · a delicious meal / cake
items.meaning: very, very good to eat or drink
items.example: Thank you for dinner. It was **delicious**!
more: These strawberries are **delicious**. Where did you buy them?
Mum made a **delicious** chocolate cake for my birthday.
items.watchOut: Delicious уже означає «дуже смачний», тому very delicious кажуть рідко. Краще really delicious або просто delicious. Вимова: /dɪˈlɪʃəs/.

items.phrase: Could I have the bill, please?
items.pattern: Could I / Can I / Could we have the bill, please?
items.meaning: a polite way to ask to pay at the end of a meal
items.example: Dad looked at his watch and said, '**Could I have the bill, please**?'
more: We asked for **the bill** and paid by card.
At the end of the meal, Grandpa paid **the bill**.
items.watchOut: Рахунок у кафе — the bill (американською the check). Не account і не count.

warmup.explain: Ready to order: після ready тут to + дієслово.
У кафе, коли обираєш страву, кажуть I'll have … або I'd like …
How would you like your steak? — питання про те, як приготувати.
Британською картопля фрі — chips. Crisps (і американське potato chips) — це чіпси в пакеті.

warmup.uk: На десерт у нас було морозиво.
warmup.explain: Десерт — dessert (дві s). Desert з однією s — пустеля.

warmup.uk: Мені стейк, будь ласка, добре просмажений.

warmup.explain: У питанні would стоїть перед you: What would you like to drink?

A.q: It's three hours before dinner. Let's have a quick ___, like an apple.
A.explain: Перекус між прийомами їжі — a snack.

A.q: This café doesn't serve ___. You can only have tea, coffee or juice.
A.explain: Alcohol — алкоголь. Сік — це якраз soft drink.

A.q: A ___ is more expensive than a café, and you go there for a full meal.
A.explain: Ресторан — restaurant: там сидять і обідають, і це дорожче, ніж у кафе.

B.q: Steak, burger or curry? Which ___ would you like?
B.explain: Стейк, бургер і карі — це основні страви, main course.

B.q: The vegetable curry has a small (v) on the menu. That means it's ___.
B.explain: (v) у меню — vegetarian, страва без м'яса й риби.

B.q: In Britain, ___ are long pieces of fried potato.
B.explain: Chips — картопля фрі. Crisps — чіпси, new potatoes — молода картопля.

C.q: At the end of the meal, Dad asked for the ___.
C.explain: Наприкінці просять рахунок — the bill. Меню потрібне на початку.

C.q: This cake is ___! Can I have another piece?
C.explain: Delicious — дуже смачний. Rare і well-done — про те, як просмажене м'ясо.

C.q: Waiter: Are you ready to order? Customer: Yes, ___ the fish, please.
C.explain: I'd like — «я хотів би», ввічливе замовлення. I like — «мені подобається».

example.title: Grandma's birthday dinner
example.uk:
У суботу в бабусі був день народження, тож ми пішли в ресторан. Офіціант дав нам меню.

«Ви готові зробити замовлення?» — запитав він. «Так, — сказала бабуся. — Мені, будь ласка, суп дня». Тато взяв стейк з картоплею фрі. Моя сестра вегетаріанка, тож вона взяла овочеве карі.

На десерт я взяла шоколадне морозиво. Усе було дуже смачне. Наприкінці тато сказав: «Можна рахунок, будь ласка?» Бабуся всміхнулася: «Який чудовий вечір!»
example.en:
On Saturday it was Grandma's birthday, so we went to a [[restaurant|a5]]. The waiter gave us the [[menu|b1]].

'Are you [[ready to order|c1]]?' he asked. 'Yes,' said Grandma. '[[I'd like|c2]] the [[soup of the day|b3]], please.' Dad had a [[steak|b6]] with [[chips|b7]]. My sister is [[vegetarian|b17]], so she had the vegetable [[curry|b9]].

For [[dessert|b14]] I had chocolate [[ice cream|b15]]. Everything was [[delicious|c9]]. At the end Dad said, '[[Could I have the bill, please|c10]]?' Grandma smiled: 'What a lovely evening!'
